notes.purpose: Quest tasks that accept any of several items or an item tag: the smart filter item (ftbfiltersystem:smart_filter) carries the expression in its ftbfiltersystem:filter component. FTB Quests 2101.1.34 ships its ItemMatchingSystem without adapters; FTB XMod Compat registers the FTB Filter System one (ftbquests/filtering/FFSSetup). Elias approved FTB Filter System on 27 September 2026 and FTB XMod Compat the same day.
